# Grok Tesla

> Portable memory for voice AI agents. Grok reads this repo by URL and picks up where the last session with the user ended.

Memory version 2026-11-27 · code "royal horizon". Read the boot pack first and load more only when you need it. Speak the user's language.

## Start here

- [Boot pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateoscarponi/grok-tesla/main/packs/boot.md): rules, where we left off and what to load next (about 995 tokens)
- [Spoken recap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateoscarponi/grok-tesla/main/packs/spoken.txt): what to say when the session starts

## More memory

- [Brief pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateoscarponi/grok-tesla/main/packs/brief.md): all current memory, most important first (about 696 tokens)
- [Full pack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateoscarponi/grok-tesla/main/packs/full.md): instructions, roles and all memory in one file (about 3,813 tokens)
- [Self-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mateoscarponi/grok-tesla/main/packs/check.md): questions that prove the memory loaded
